question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS promo_net
    FROM fact_sales
    WHERE is_promo = TRUE
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN total_net = 0 THEN NULL 
         ELSE promo_net / total_net 
    END AS promo_net_ratio
FROM promo_sales, total_sales

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了

        p.category,

        SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 8 THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS aug_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id

FROM monthly_sales

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet d ON f.outlet_id = d.outlet_id
    GROUP BY d.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        net_sales,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS total_sales
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region,
    net_sales,
    running_total / total_sales AS cumulative_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 有多少个终端和单品的铺货组合在2026年8月完全没有销售
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS combo_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.outlet_id, p.sku_id
    FROM dim_outlet o
    CROSS JOIN dim_product p
    WHERE o.is_active = TRUE
      AND p.is_active = TRUE
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM rel_outlet_sku ros
          WHERE ros.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
            AND ros.sku_id = p.sku_id
            AND (ros.delisted_date IS NULL OR ros.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
            AND ros.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fact_sales fs
          JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
          WHERE fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
            AND fs.sku_id = p.sku_id
            AND dd.year = 2026
            AND dd.month = 8
      )
) t

question: 哪些业务代表的拜访次数高于平均值
sql:
WITH rep_visits AS (
    SELECT rep_id, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
    FROM fact_visit
    GROUP BY rep_id
),
avg_visits AS (
    SELECT AVG(visit_count) AS avg_count
    FROM rep_visits
)
SELECT r.rep_name
FROM rep_visits rv
JOIN dim_rep r ON rv.rep_id = r.rep_id
CROSS JOIN avg_visits av
WHERE rv.visit_count > av.avg_count

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少

sql:
WITH period_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN YEAR(f.date_key) = 2025 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN '2025H2'
            WHEN YEAR(f.date_key) = 2026 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN '2026H1'
        END AS period,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales,
        SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS promo_cost
    FROM fact_sales f
    LEFT JOIN fact_promo_cost pc 
        ON f.date_key = pc.date_key 
        AND f.outlet_id = pc.outlet_id 
        AND f.sku_id = pc.sku_id 
        AND f.dealer_id = pc.dealer_id
    WHERE (YEAR(f.date_key) = 2025 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 7 AND 12)
       OR (YEAR(f.date_key) = 2026 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 6)
    GROUP BY period
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT promo_cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) FROM period_metrics WHERE period = '2026H1') -
    (SELECT promo_cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) FROM period_metrics WHERE period = '2025H2') AS fee_ratio_diff
